failures.root_cause: Environmental CPU fluctuation on shared cloud Codespace. Measured average 7.027ms vs aggressive 5ms test assertion, well within production non-blocking 30ms budget.

failures.root_cause: audit_memory() flagged Oversized files: 2 (ARCHITECTURE.md at 302 lines and PROCEDURES.md at 798 lines exceed the 250-line compactness limit), causing overall status to be NEEDS_MAINTENANCE.

filename_inspection_tests.issue: Merely checks substrings in returned filenames ('git.md', 'frontend.md', 'database.md') rather than validating semantic boundaries or content completeness.

constant_assertion_tests.issue: Directly asserts module-level constant dictionary values (e.g. SOURCE_TIER_WEIGHTS['USER_EXPLICIT'] == 1.0).
Merely asserts file existence and static text substring in markdown files.
Merely checks os.path.exists('/workspaces/codespaces-blank/AGENTS.md') rather than probing live state mutation.
Merely creates a local hardcoded dictionary and checks its keys.

mock_instead_of_real_integration.issue: Uses MockQueueManager to stub the index queue manager instead of testing integration with IndexQueueManager.
Uses MockMemSearchAdapter to simulate offline/failure states instead of real connection/subprocesses.
Stubs backend.index with a lambda function returning False rather than triggering an actual backend error.

Hybrid retrieval outperforms lexical baseline on evaluation corpus
Superseded memory is not returned as current authoritative truth
Historical as-of queries recover superseded information
A stale evidence citation reduces trust
Missing citation prevents automatically promoted high-authority fact
Candidate memories never appear in authoritative retrieval unless requested
Exact duplicate candidates do not create duplicate durable records
Semantic duplicate candidates are detected
True conflicts create a review/reconciliation path
Scope boundaries prevent project-to-project leakage
Secret-scanning remains enforced
Automatic capture is idempotent
Indexing failures do not corrupt canonical memory
Index failures are observable
Concurrent indexing is serialized correctly via file locks
Embedding-model changes are detected
System can rebuild derived semantic index from canonical memory
System can operate in lexical fallback mode
Procedural candidates are not silently installed
Memory feedback distinguishes invisible from visible-but-unused results
Unknown queries trigger abstention rather than fabricated recall
Current-state questions verify live state when evidence is mutable
Historical questions retrieve historical memory
Final health report has zero contradictory statuses
The benchmark itself is deterministic where deterministic scoring is possible
